subject.title: Feature: force media delivery as document attachment (e.g. #doc)

question: Should OpenClaw add a durable force-document contract beyond the shipped per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` flags, and if so should it be `MEDIA:#doc`, a channel-level default, or another explicit message/media option?
rationale: The remaining work changes public media syntax or channel config defaults, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config/env surfaces and channel contracts.

options.title: Decide a canonical contract first
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose the syntax/default semantics, then implement one documented path instead of adding parallel ad hoc behavior.

options.title: Limit support to per-call flags
options.body: Close or narrow this issue if maintainers decide `forceDocument`/`asDocument` are the only supported contract and durable defaults should not exist.

options.title: Accept a channel default
options.body: Add a channel-level default only with explicit upgrade behavior, docs, and tests proving existing sends are not unexpectedly changed.

recommendation.title: Decide a canonical contract first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose the syntax/default semantics, then implement one documented path instead of adding parallel ad hoc behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses the shared outbound contract rather than only one plugin implementation.
